node.title: Rank-eleven factor-flag clone/line dichotomy
node.closure: weighted rank-at-most-two triple incidences split into an active massive projective clone bucket or a massive genuine evaluation-line triple
node.statement: In the base-free KoalaBear rank-eleven 2 x 5 factor branch, the deep residual classes have mass at least 30210771209598495 and at least 37736 common-zero coordinates each. Rank-three coordinate triples carry at most the four-space cap 63397365764 apiece, leaving weighted low-rank triple incidence at least 255859400991343449179217479656. If all projective clone classes of residual B-evaluation columns have size at most C, convex packing and the eight-space cap give a genuine rank-two triple of mass at least ceil(max(0,I_low-R_8 T_clone(C))/C(1116048,3)). At C=10000, balancing the remaining line and large-clone incidence gives either an active projective clone of at least 10001 coordinates carrying at least 388650911452 first-owned slopes, or a rank-exactly-two triple carrying at least the same mass. Neither horn is paid or identified with an owner-pencil clone/split pencil here.
